records.issue_text: Pagination tests are missing coverage for 0, 50, and 51 members and removal from the last page, so page-count and empty-final-page regressions are not caught
records.rationale: The diff introduces new pagination logic in admin-group.js.es6 with currentPage and totalPages computed properties, and adds next/previous actions.
